Group 06

# TroMate

## Use Case Specification

**Version 1.0**

| TroMate | Version: 1.0 |
| --- | --- |
| Use-Case Specification: Shared Expenses and Debt Settlement | Date: 29/Oct/2026 |
| Document identifier: TROMATE-UC-SPEC-1.0 | Status: Complete draft for team review |

This document specifies the 11 use cases in TroMate's current model, including normal behavior, alternative flows, permissions, financial outcomes and applicable quality requirements. It covers text and receipt logging, utility bills, explicit expense approval, debt simplification, manual settlement, reminders and the basic ledger/dashboard. UC06 Auto-Accept Expense is excluded while research continues. Unanswered proposals remain pending.

## 1. Use-case Model

### 1.1 Diagram and relationships

![TroMate use-case model with 11 active use cases](data:image/png;base64,)

Figure 1. Current use-case model. The image is embedded in this Markdown file and requires no separate asset or rendering service.

The diagram preserves the current use-case IDs and the existing Member/Lead generalization. The background engine belongs inside TroMate and is not an external actor. UC09's former label, “Generate Dynamic VietQR & Confirmation,” is clarified to **Generate Dynamic VietQR**: UC09 supplies payment instructions; the creditor's receipt confirmation belongs to UC08. These modeling clarifications do not add or remove a scoped capability.

| Relationship | Meaning in this specification |
| --- | --- |
| Room Financial Lead specializes Room Member | The lead has member capabilities and may submit utility meter/invoice data through UC04. |
| UC01 includes UC03b | Text logging always invokes interpretation and split validation. |
| UC02 includes UC03a | Receipt logging always invokes extraction, which invokes UC03b. |
| UC04 includes UC03a | Meter/invoice scanning always invokes extraction and contextual interpretation. |
| UC03a includes UC03b | Extracted text is normalized/interpreted before returning to the parent; a clarification result can be returned without inventing missing values. |
| UC08 includes UC09 | The normal settlement route obtains exact payment instructions; the documented manual-transfer alternative can recover when QR generation fails. |
| Confirmed ledger changes trigger UC07 | Confirmation and settlement refresh derived balances; this is an internal event, not an external actor. |
| Due settlement events trigger UC10 | The schedule initiates reminders at the specified intervals. |

### 1.2 Scope and actors

| Actor or supporting participant | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Room Member / Active Shared-Cost Contributor | Submit expenses, review involved proposals, view authorized room data and settle obligations. A member can be an expense payer, beneficiary, settlement debtor or settlement creditor. |
| Room Financial Lead / Representative | Inherits member capabilities; submits utility meter and landlord-invoice data. Being lead alone does not grant authority to confirm another creditor's receipt. |
| Telegram platform | Delivers authorized messages, photos and button actions, hosts the Mini App, and receives TroMate notifications. |
| Member's bank application | Performs the external transfer. TroMate does not execute or independently observe a bank transfer in this release. |

The baseline is the PA1 Vision Small Project document, version 1.0, targeting Telegram workspaces for shared rooms of 2–5 members. Features 1–8 are represented by the current model. Feature 9 utility anomaly detection and Feature 10 monthly analytics are later scope; category charts are not unconditional dashboard functionality. Existing Free/Pro entitlements affect OCR and history access, but subscription purchase, room creation/joining, bank-account maintenance, automated bank verification and confirmed-entry correction administration are not additional use cases in this deliverable. An active room, its member list and recipient bank details are setup inputs; UC11 displays permitted room settings. Missing setup is handled explicitly rather than fabricated.

UC06 is removed from the current diagram and specifications by the agreed scope decision. Research into auto-accept remains open and does not block this deliverable. No actor can obtain approval by silence, and no approval timeout is specified.

### 1.3 Common rules and elaboration assumptions

**Baseline rules** below come from the agreed Vision and its referenced project decision record. **EA assumptions** make the under-specified branches executable in this draft; they require team review and are not represented as prior consensus. No flow depends on an unanswered policy question: a conservative supported route or an explicit unsupported-operation outcome is given.

| Rule | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| BR01 Room access | Financial information and actions are scoped to an authenticated, authorized room member. Recheck room identity and permission before a save. |
| BR02 Explicit approval | A new expense is a `PENDING` proposal. Only explicit confirmation can commit it to the official ledger; a rejection or no response cannot create confirmed debt. |
| BR03 Ledger and settlement | Confirmed expense and settlement records are auditable. Derived net balances include confirmed expenses and confirmed receipts only. Generating/scanning a QR or uploading evidence does not confirm receipt of funds. |
| BR04 Product tiers | Free rooms share 10 OCR scans/month and have 30-day transaction history. Pro has unlimited scans and history. Monthly analytics are outside the current use cases. |
| EA01 Approval quorum and editing, covering catalogue D01/D02 | Every distinct involved person, including the recorded payer, must explicitly agree to the current version. Submission alone is not a vote. Any involved member can edit a pending proposal; any financial change clears all approvals. One rejection freezes the current version as disputed until corrected or cancelled. The creator can cancel an unconfirmed proposal. Confirmed records cannot be overwritten through these use cases. |
| EA02 Interpretation, covering D03 | Currency is VND. Supported splits are equal shares, named fixed shares and explicit one-to-one debts. The sender is the default payer. A missing beneficiary list defaults to all current room members, displayed for review; a stated participant count inconsistent with that list requires clarification. A different named payer is allowed but must approve. Unassigned receipt items require an explicit shared-participant selection. Unsupported percentages, multi-payer expenses and foreign currencies are rejected with supported alternatives. |
| EA03 Exact amounts, covering D04 | Expense totals and final shares are positive/nonnegative integer VND respectively. The total is positive; zero-share members are not charged. Equal division uses floor(total / participants); the remaining đồng are allocated one each by ascending stable member ID. The full allocation is displayed and must sum exactly to the total. The payer's own share creates no self-debt. Refunds/negative-total expenses require a separate correction process and are unsupported here. |
| EA04 OCR quota, covering D05 | The monthly boundary is the calendar month in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Reserve one Free scan before extraction; concurrent requests cannot exceed the quota. Consume it when useful extraction data is returned, even if later corrected, rejected or cancelled. Release the reservation for an unsupported input, technical failure or wholly unreadable image. Replaying/retrying the same operation never consumes a second scan. A fresh resubmission is a new scan. |
| EA05 Utilities, covering D06 | A billing period, previous/current reading and applicable unit price are explicit reviewed inputs. Usage = current − previous; charge = usage × unit price. Fixed rent and itemized fees are added once. Zero usage/fees are valid; missing data is not zero. Fractional currency results require an explicitly corrected integer-VND bill amount. Meter reset/replacement, tiered tariffs and automatic occupancy proration are unsupported; the lead supplies reviewed corrected values or a fixed-share allocation. |
| EA06 Receipt and discrepancies, covering D07/D08 | Only the creditor can confirm receipt; a lead can do so only when also the creditor. The normal debtor claim includes an uploaded transfer image, which is supporting evidence. A creditor who independently checks their bank record may confirm a matching direct transfer without that image. Exact full settlement is supported; partial, excess or wrong-recipient transfers are recorded as discrepancies without clearing the obligation or prompting another full payment before reconciliation. A debtor may withdraw an unconfirmed claim, but not undo a confirmed receipt. |
| EA07 Reminders, covering D09 | Reminder intervals are 24h and 48h after an outstanding obligation is first published. Suppress debtor reminders while receipt confirmation/discrepancy review is pending. Recheck status before sending. After downtime, send only the latest due unsent interval, not a burst. Replayed jobs reuse the interval's delivery record; uncertain delivery is not blindly resent. |
| EA08 History and membership, covering D10/D12 | The Free 30-day window applies to settled historical detail; unresolved obligations and the minimum evidence needed to reconcile them remain available to authorized members until resolved. A downgrade restricts older settled history, and a later upgrade does not promise restoration of expired data. Former members lose interactive access; their recorded obligations are preserved for authorized room reconciliation. |
| EA09 In-flight obligations, covering D12 | Issued payment references retain their original debtor, creditor, amount and bank-detail snapshot. Recalculation must preserve or reconcile them rather than silently redirect a transfer. Reserve the referenced amount while a payment instruction/claim is active; new expenses form separately calculated obligations. A debtor can release an instruction after explicitly confirming no transfer was made; uncertain or claimed transfers remain under receipt review. |
| EA10 Input and recovery limits, covering D13 | Application input is one JPEG/PNG image up to 10 MiB per scan; these are draft application limits, not claims about Telegram's limits. A transient extraction/generation/delivery operation has one automatic retry after checking its recorded outcome; a 10-second attempt timeout leads to explicit failure/processing feedback. Response-time targets in Section 1.5 still apply. An uncertain financial save must be checked by operation identity before retry. No automatic retry sends a bank transfer. |

Expense states are `PENDING`, `PENDING` with a dispute flag, `CONFIRMED` and `CANCELLED`. Settlement states are **Awaiting payment**, **Awaiting receipt confirmation**, **Discrepancy under review** and **Settled**. The discrepancy state is a non-settled review outcome. Approval history and revisions are separate from the immutable confirmed ledger.

The following examples illustrate exact arithmetic. A, B and C are in ascending stable member-ID order; proposed allocations affect official balances only after UC05 confirmation.

| Input | Reviewed allocation or result |
| --- | --- |
| A pays 200,000 VND, equally shared by A/B/C. | Shares: A 66,667; B 66,667; C 66,666. After confirmation B owes A 66,667 and C owes A 66,666; A has no self-debt. |
| A pays a 240,000 VND receipt: A's item 55,000, B's item 55,000, C's item 60,000, shared items 70,000 among A/B/C. | Shared amounts: A 23,334; B/C 23,333 each. Final shares: A 78,334; B 78,333; C 83,333, totaling 240,000. After confirmation B/C owe A 78,333/83,333. |
| Rent 3,000,000; electricity readings 1,200 to 1,275 at 3,500 VND/unit; water 100,000; fees 50,000. | Electricity = (1,275 − 1,200) × 3,500 = 262,500. Total = 3,412,500; an equal three-person allocation is 1,137,500 each. |
| Confirmed obligations A→B 100,000; B→C 100,000; C→A 100,000, with no active transfer reservations. | Every net position is zero. UC07 produces no payment instruction and preserves the underlying ledger. |

### 1.4 Shared alternative flows

The following flows apply at the entry, validation, save and delivery points named in each specification. They are part of each referenced Alternative Flows field; they are not extra use cases. For an internal included case, its caller performs the user interaction and resumes its named step.

| ID | Entry and alternative flow | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SH01 Missing room setup | At room selection/validation, the chat has no valid workspace. 1. Explain the missing setup. 2. End the operation; after setup, the actor restarts the use case from step 1. Never select another chat's room implicitly. | No financial change or cross-room disclosure. |
| SH02 Unauthorized or expired session | At entry or before any protected save/read, credentials or permission are invalid. 1. Reauthenticate where possible. 2. Recheck current room access. Resume the interrupted validation step only if authorized; otherwise end without exposing protected data. | Existing records unchanged; authorized continuation only. |
| SH03 Duplicate action | At receipt/save/delivery, the same operation identity is received again. 1. Read the previous result. 2. Return it or resume its unfinished stage once. Similar content with a different identity follows the relevant possible-duplicate alternative. | At most one proposal, vote, quota consumption, settlement or interval reminder for that operation. |
| SH04 Stale state | Before acting, the version, membership, obligation, bank details or entitlement changed. 1. Refresh current data. 2. Show material changes. Return to the case's review step and require current approval; if no longer eligible, use SH02. | No stale approval or silently changed transfer instructions. |
| SH05 Failure or uncertain result | At processing/save/delivery, an operation fails or its result is unknown. 1. Establish whether it committed. 2. Retry only the unfinished stage under EA10. 3. Return accurate saved/pending/failure status. A saved financial result survives a notification failure. | Existing durable state preserved; no fabricated zero balance, duplicate commitment or instruction to pay again. |
| SH06 Cancellation or abandonment | Before final commitment, the actor cancels/leaves. 1. Stop the interaction. 2. Show any already saved pending state. An expense remains pending unless its creator explicitly cancels it; an uncertain external transfer remains unresolved for bank/creditor checking. | No new commitment from abandonment; saved/external outcomes are not silently reversed. |
| SH07 Member departure | At validation/review, a member leaves the room. 1. Refresh permissions and affected pending participants. 2. Request a valid current allocation for unconfirmed proposals, or preserve existing confirmed obligations for authorized reconciliation. Apply EA08/EA09. | No deletion or redistribution of an outstanding debt merely because membership changed. |

### 1.5 Applicable Vision constraints

These are requirements and design constraints, not measured implementation results. V-NFR labels are local document references.

| Reference | Requirement and application |
| --- | --- |
| V-NFR01 Performance | Text command/message parsing response under 1.5 seconds; OCR image parsing under 3.5 seconds. Applies to UC01–UC04, including UC03a/UC03b. Record request/response timing during later implementation validation; the Vision does not prescribe a percentile or load profile. |
| V-NFR02 Concurrency | Group-state concurrency control uses Redis distributed locks with TTL 300 seconds. Apply to concurrent proposal/approval processing. TTL is infrastructure lifetime, not an expense-approval deadline. |
| V-NFR03 Availability | Target 99.5% availability for webhook processing and scheduled reminders. Applies to chat flows and UC10, with retry and delivery-status alternatives. |
| V-NFR04 Transport and storage | Webhook/API communications use TLS 1.3. Financial ledgers persist in PostgreSQL and access is restricted to authorized room members. |
| V-NFR05 Isolation | Expenses, bank details and history are isolated by room. Every protected query, claim, QR and confirmation must use the authorized room context. |
| V-NFR06 Usability | Natural-language input, readable previews and inline Agree/Reject/Edit/Payment actions support use without training. Error prompts identify the field/action requiring correction. |
| V-NFR07 Auditability | Preserve immutable confirmed records and explicit confirmation/rejection/revision history. Rejection of a pending proposal does not erase an existing confirmed entry. |
| V-NFR08 Fault tolerance | Queue webhook retries safely and support manual correction of low-confidence OCR. Duplicate delivery cannot create duplicate debt, quota use or receipt confirmation. |

## 2. Use-case Specifications

### 2.1 UC01 Log Expense via Natural Text

| Use case Name | UC01 Log Expense via Natural Text |
| --- | --- |
| Brief description | A member turns a Vietnamese expense/debt message into a reviewable pending proposal without manually entering a full form. |
| Actors | Primary: Room Member, including Room Financial Lead. Supporting: Telegram platform. UC03b is included internal behavior. |
| Trigger | A member submits an apparent shared-expense or debt message in the bound group. |
| Basic Flow | 1. The member sends an expense message, such as “Tiền lẩu 200k nha ae”.<br>2. TroMate verifies the sender's current membership and the bound room.<br>3. TroMate invokes UC03b to normalize the text, identify the payer/beneficiaries and calculate exact shares.<br>4. TroMate displays the amount, description, payer, participant list and shares for review; the sender can correct the interpretation.<br>5. TroMate saves one versioned `PENDING` proposal and broadcasts Agree/Reject/Edit actions to involved members.<br>6. TroMate displays the proposal's pending status and hands review to UC05. Official balances remain unchanged until UC05 confirms the proposal. |
| Alternative Flows | **UC01-AF01 One-to-one debt.** At step 3, the message names one debtor and creditor. 1. Resolve the two identities and amount. 2. Display only that allocation. Return to step 4; uninvolved members are not charged.<br><br>**UC01-AF02 Named or unequal shares.** At step 3, the message specifies a subset or fixed amounts. 1. Validate each named share using UC03b and EA02/EA03. 2. Show the payer's own share separately if applicable. Return to step 4 with the exact allocation.<br><br>**UC01-AF03 Non-expense or unsupported intent.** At step 3, the message is ordinary conversation or a different intent. 1. Ignore clear non-expense chat without creating a proposal. 2. For an apparent logging attempt, explain supported input and ask for clarification. End for conversation, or repeat step 3 after clarification.<br><br>**UC01-AF04 Missing or ambiguous information.** At step 3, UC03b returns questions about the amount, payer, nickname or participants. 1. Show the specific question and current extracted fields. 2. The member supplies the missing selection/value. Repeat step 3; no official debt is created while unresolved.<br><br>**UC01-AF05 Invalid amount or unreconciled split.** At steps 3–4, total/currency/shares fail validation. 1. Identify the invalid value or difference. 2. The member corrects it or chooses a supported split. Repeat step 3 and then step 4; an invalid proposal cannot be committed.<br><br>**UC01-AF06 Corrected interpretation.** At step 4, the member changes fields. 1. TroMate updates the preview and validates the changed participants/amounts. 2. The member reviews the revised allocation. Repeat step 4, then continue to step 5 when valid.<br><br>**UC01-AF07 Possible duplicate purchase.** Before step 5, a similar existing expense is found. 1. Show the possible match without exposing another room. 2. The member selects the existing proposal or explicitly identifies a separate purchase. End with the existing result, or continue to step 5 for a new purchase. Identical-delivery retries use SH03.<br><br>**UC01-AF08 Source message changed or withdrawn.** After step 5, an identifiable supported edit/withdrawal event or explicit cancellation request is received. 1. Apply creator/involved-member permissions under EA01. 2. Revise the pending proposal and clear approvals, or cancel it. Resume UC05 step 1 for a revision, or end cancelled. If already confirmed, preserve the entry and explain that a separate auditable correction is required. Message deletion is not assumed observable on every platform event.<br><br>**UC01-AF09 Parser, save or broadcast failure.** At steps 3 or 5, processing fails. 1. Apply SH05 and show the actual result. 2. Offer supported field correction after parser failure; preserve a saved proposal if only broadcast failed. Resume step 3 or the unfinished part of step 5, or end with explicit failure/pending status.<br><br>**Shared alternatives:** SH01/SH02 at step 2; SH03 at steps 1/5; SH04 at steps 3–5 returns to step 4; SH05 at steps 3/5; SH06 before step 5; SH07 before step 5 or during UC05 review. |
| Pre-conditions | Telegram has delivered the message to TroMate. Successful logging requires an active bound room and current member; invalid access follows the shared alternatives. |
| Post-conditions | Success: exactly one pending proposal with visible exact allocation is available to UC05. Failure/cancellation: no new confirmed ledger entry or debt. A saved proposal remains visible even if its notification is delayed. |
| Rules and constraints | BR01–BR04; EA01–EA03 and EA10. Vision Features 1 and 6; V-NFR01–V-NFR08 as applicable. |

### 2.2 UC02 Log Expense via Receipt Photo

| Use case Name | UC02 Log Expense via Receipt Photo |
| --- | --- |
| Brief description | A member submits a receipt image with optional text and obtains a reviewed, itemized pending expense. |
| Actors | Primary: Room Member. Supporting: Telegram platform. Includes UC03a, which includes UC03b. |
| Trigger | A member uploads a receipt/photo message in the bound room. |
| Basic Flow | 1. The member uploads one receipt image with an optional allocation caption.<br>2. TroMate verifies room access, the image's supported format and current scan entitlement; it reserves one Free scan if applicable.<br>3. TroMate invokes UC03a, including UC03b, to extract items/totals and interpret the caption and allocation.<br>4. TroMate shows the image alongside extracted values, payer, beneficiaries and exact shares. The member reviews/corrects uncertain values until all amounts reconcile.<br>5. TroMate saves one versioned `PENDING` proposal and broadcasts Agree/Reject/Edit actions with the reviewed allocation.<br>6. TroMate displays pending status and hands review to UC05. Extraction or review alone does not change official balances. |
| Alternative Flows | **UC02-AF01 Free quota exhausted.** At step 2, no scan remains. 1. Show the quota and calendar reset. 2. Offer text logging through UC01 and explain existing Pro entitlement options without initiating a purchase. End the scan without OCR or a quota charge.<br><br>**UC02-AF02 Pro room.** At step 2, current entitlement is Pro. 1. Verify room entitlement. 2. Skip the Free quota restriction. Continue to step 3.<br><br>**UC02-AF03 Unsupported or unreadable image.** At steps 2–3, UC03a rejects the media or finds no usable receipt. 1. Explain the specific failure and release an unconsumed reservation. 2. Request a supported clearer image or offer UC01. Return to step 1 for replacement, or end without a proposal.<br><br>**UC02-AF04 No caption.** At step 3, allocation instructions are absent. 1. Propose the sender as payer and all current members as equal beneficiaries under EA02. 2. Display the full list for correction. Continue to step 4; ambiguous participant counts still require clarification.<br><br>**UC02-AF05 Caption conflicts with receipt.** At step 3, caption totals, names or items disagree with extraction. 1. Show the conflict. 2. Ask the member to select/correct the relevant values. Repeat interpretation at step 3 using the saved extraction, then return to step 4; no new OCR scan is required merely to correct text.<br><br>**UC02-AF06 Personal and shared items.** At step 3, some items are assigned individually. 1. Allocate those quantities to their named people. 2. Request explicit participants for remaining shared items and calculate their shares. Continue to step 4 when every item is assigned exactly once.<br><br>**UC02-AF07 Total mismatch, tax or discount.** At steps 3–4, line allocations differ from the payable total. 1. Show the difference and any extracted tax/discount/fee. 2. The member supplies a reconciled payable total and allocation, preserving a positive expense total. Repeat step 4; do not silently spread unexplained charges.<br><br>**UC02-AF08 Manual correction.** At step 4, OCR fields or shares are corrected. 1. Preserve the original image and revised values for review. 2. Revalidate amounts and identities without repeating OCR. Repeat step 4, then continue to step 5 when valid.<br><br>**UC02-AF09 Possible reused receipt.** Before step 5, a matching receipt is already recorded. 1. Show the existing proposal/entry. 2. The member identifies it as the same expense or a separate purchase. End with the existing result, or continue to step 5 with an explicitly distinct purchase; SH03 handles identical operation retries.<br><br>**UC02-AF10 Quota race, entitlement change or cancellation.** At steps 2–5, eligibility changes or the member leaves. 1. Resolve the scan reservation against current entitlement before extraction. 2. Apply EA04/SH06: consume a useful completed extraction once, release an unconsumed reservation, and preserve any saved pending proposal. Resume the eligible stage, or end with actual quota/proposal status.<br><br>**UC02-AF11 Processing or publication failure.** At steps 3 or 5, extraction/save/broadcast fails. 1. Apply UC03a's failure result and SH05. 2. Restore the correct quota result under EA04 and retain any saved proposal. Retry the unfinished stage once under EA10, or end with explicit failure/pending status.<br><br>**Shared alternatives:** SH01/SH02 at step 2; SH03 at steps 1–3/5; SH04 before step 5 returns to step 4; SH05 at steps 3/5; SH06 before commitment; SH07 during allocation or UC05 review. |
| Pre-conditions | Telegram has delivered an uploaded image/message. Room membership, supported media and scan eligibility are checked in step 2 rather than assumed to make failure paths unreachable. |
| Post-conditions | Success: one itemized pending proposal, consumed scan accounting exactly as EA04 and no official balance change. Failure: no confirmed expense; unusable/failed extraction does not consume a Free scan. Later rejection does not refund a useful completed extraction. |
| Rules and constraints | BR01–BR04; EA01–EA04 and EA10. Vision Features 2 and 6; V-NFR01–V-NFR08 as applicable. |

### 2.3 UC03a Vision OCR Data Extraction

| Use case Name | UC03a Vision OCR Data Extraction |
| --- | --- |
| Brief description | Extract usable receipt/invoice/meter data and return interpreted fields or precise correction questions to the invoking use case. |
| Actors | Initiating actor is the Room Member through UC02, or Room Financial Lead through UC04. TroMate performs this included behavior internally; its background engine is not an external actor. |
| Trigger | An authorized parent use case submits a scan request and media reference. |
| Basic Flow | 1. TroMate receives the scan operation identity, authorized room context, document kind, image reference and any caption.<br>2. TroMate fetches the image and validates the application format/size and scan reservation.<br>3. TroMate extracts text, item lines, totals or meter digits, preserving source locations and uncertainty where available.<br>4. TroMate checks that useful document fields exist and identifies unreadable or conflicting values without fabricating them.<br>5. TroMate invokes UC03b with the extracted text, document context and caption to normalize and interpret it.<br>6. TroMate returns the extraction, interpreted fields and any clarification request to UC02 step 4 or UC04 step 4, and finalizes the scan result under EA04. No ledger entry is confirmed here. |
| Alternative Flows | **UC03a-AF01 Media unavailable.** At step 2, the image cannot be fetched or has expired. 1. Return a media-unavailable result. 2. The parent requests a new upload at UC02 step 1 or UC04 step 1. End extraction without consuming a scan.<br><br>**UC03a-AF02 Unsupported media.** At step 2, input is not one JPEG/PNG up to 10 MiB. 1. Return the allowed application limits. 2. The parent requests replacement. End this attempt; restart from step 1 with a new supported input.<br><br>**UC03a-AF03 No useful extraction.** At steps 3–4, blur, glare, cropping or absent text prevents useful extraction. 1. Return the specific unreadable/missing-field explanation. 2. The parent offers a new photo or supported manual/text correction. End this extraction without a quota charge; no default zero amount is returned.<br><br>**UC03a-AF04 Partial low-confidence result.** At step 4, some useful fields exist but others are uncertain. 1. Preserve and mark the uncertain fields. 2. Continue to step 5 with a clarification-required result, then step 6. The parent cannot approve a financial proposal until the member supplies complete validated values.<br><br>**UC03a-AF05 Multiple documents or conflicting totals.** At step 4, one unambiguous document cannot be selected. 1. Return the conflict and request a single-document crop/selection. 2. The parent obtains a replacement at its image-submission step. End the ambiguous extraction; a fresh useful rescan follows EA04.<br><br>**UC03a-AF06 Provider failure or timeout.** At step 3, extraction is unavailable or exceeds EA10's attempt timeout. 1. Retry once safely for the same operation. 2. If unsuccessful, return processing failure and release the reservation. The parent resumes replacement/manual entry or ends without a proposal.<br><br>**UC03a-AF07 Invalid handoff or interpretation failure.** At steps 4–6, fields fail validation or UC03b cannot complete interpretation. 1. Preserve any useful OCR result and its one-time quota outcome. 2. Return precise correction questions or processing failure to the parent. On corrected text, resume step 5 without another OCR charge; otherwise end with explicit incomplete status.<br><br>**Shared alternatives:** Parent authorization/quota failures occur before this case and are propagated if discovered at steps 1–2. SH03 applies at step 1; SH04 before step 6 refreshes context; SH05 applies to steps 2–6, with the parent receiving the final result. |
| Pre-conditions | UC02 or UC04 has established a valid room context and attempted to reserve eligible scanning capacity. The image's actual availability/readability is validated within this use case. |
| Post-conditions | Success: caller receives useful extracted/normalized data with uncertainties and correct scan accounting. Failure: caller receives an actionable failure, not fabricated financial data. Neither outcome confirms a debt or verifies bank receipt. |
| Rules and constraints | BR01/BR04; EA04/EA10. Vision Features 2 and 3; V-NFR01, V-NFR04, V-NFR05 and V-NFR08. |

### 2.4 UC03b Parse Intent and Split Logic

| Use case Name | UC03b Parse Intent and Split Logic (LLM/NLP) |
| --- | --- |
| Brief description | Interpret Vietnamese text or OCR output into validated expense allocation or typed utility fields, requesting clarification when the input is incomplete. |
| Actors | Initiating Room Member or Room Financial Lead through UC01/UC03a. This is internal included behavior; the parent owns the user conversation. |
| Trigger | UC01 submits text, or UC03a submits extracted document text and context. |
| Basic Flow | 1. TroMate accepts the input, document/intent context, room members and known payer/caption fields.<br>2. TroMate identifies the supported intent and normalizes VND tokens such as k, kđ, tr and củ.<br>3. TroMate resolves payer and participant names/pronouns to current room identities; utility readings are associated with the selected room/period rather than treated as purchases by themselves.<br>4. TroMate applies the supported equal/fixed/one-to-one allocation or extracts the utility components required by UC04.<br>5. TroMate validates supported currency, quantities, numeric ranges and total/share reconciliation, applying EA03 rounding where needed.<br>6. TroMate returns the typed fields and readable interpretation, or precise clarification questions, to UC01 step 4 or UC03a step 6. It does not commit a ledger entry. |
| Alternative Flows | **UC03b-AF01 Supported slang or specific allocation.** At steps 2–4, a supported currency token, one-to-one debt or named fixed split appears. 1. Normalize its units and intent. 2. Preserve the explicit people/amounts in the readable interpretation. Continue through step 5 to step 6.<br><br>**UC03b-AF02 Ambiguous amount or intent.** At step 2, separators, currency or competing totals are unclear. 1. Return the ambiguous candidates as a question. 2. The parent asks the member to specify the actual amount/intent. Resume step 2 after clarification; no valid proposal is returned before resolution.<br><br>**UC03b-AF03 Invalid or unsupported amount.** At steps 2/5, the expense total is non-positive, invalid or foreign currency, or the request is a refund. 1. Reject the invalid/unsupported financial operation with a clear explanation. 2. Offer a supported positive-VND expense or the separate correction process. Resume step 2 only after valid replacement; otherwise end without a proposal. Legitimate zero utility usage and itemized discounts are not treated as zero/negative expense totals.<br><br>**UC03b-AF04 Unknown or ambiguous person.** At step 3, an alias maps to multiple people, nobody or an ineligible former member. 1. Return the unresolved name and current eligible choices. 2. The parent obtains explicit selection. Resume step 3; never charge a guessed identity.<br><br>**UC03b-AF05 Missing participants.** At step 3, payer/list is omitted. 1. Use the visible sender/all-members default under EA02 only when no contrary participant count exists. 2. If “chia 3” conflicts with a four-member default, ask which three people. Resume step 3 after clarification, then continue to review.<br><br>**UC03b-AF06 Different payer or duplicate alias.** At step 3, the sender names another payer or repeats one identity under aliases. 1. Resolve aliases to a single member and display the intended payer. 2. Require that payer's explicit UC05 approval under EA01. Continue to step 4, or return clarification if identity remains uncertain.<br><br>**UC03b-AF07 Unassigned or unmatched item.** At step 4, a receipt item has no owner, conflicting owners or unmatched quantity. 1. Identify the unresolved item and quantity. 2. The parent asks for a personal/shared allocation. Resume step 4 when each quantity is assigned once.<br><br>**UC03b-AF08 Allocation mismatch or unsupported split form.** At steps 4–5, totals/quantities disagree or percentages/multiple payers are requested. 1. Show the difference or unsupported form. 2. Ask for reconciled fixed/equal shares. Resume step 4; no invalid allocation proceeds to a pending financial proposal.<br><br>**UC03b-AF09 Indivisible VND remainder.** At step 5, equal division leaves a remainder. 1. Apply EA03's stable-member-ID allocation. 2. Return every exact integer share and its rounding explanation. Continue to step 6 only when the shares equal the total.<br><br>**UC03b-AF10 Context change or invalid parser output.** At steps 1–6, membership changes, processing fails or generated fields are structurally/financially invalid. 1. Refresh context and validate again, with one safe processing retry under EA10. 2. If still invalid, return correction questions/failure to the parent rather than manufactured debt. Resume step 1 for refreshed context or end with an explicit incomplete result.<br><br>**Shared alternatives:** SH03 at step 1; SH04 before returning step 6 requires current identity review; SH05 for processing/handoff failure. Parent-specific authorization/cancellation outcomes remain in UC01/UC02/UC04. |
| Pre-conditions | An authorized parent supplies text and enough room/document context to attempt interpretation. Complete financial fields are a success condition, not an assumed precondition. |
| Post-conditions | Success: validated typed fields and exact financial allocation, or explicitly identified partial utility fields for UC04 review. Clarification/failure: no guessed person, amount or confirmed debt; parent receives an actionable explanation. |
| Rules and constraints | EA01–EA03, EA05 and EA10. Vision Features 1/2; V-NFR01, V-NFR04, V-NFR05, V-NFR06 and V-NFR08. |

### 2.5 UC04 Scan Utility Meter and Landlord Invoice

| Use case Name | UC04 Scan Utility Meter and Landlord Invoice |
| --- | --- |
| Brief description | The lead extracts and reviews meter/invoice values, calculates room utility costs and submits an exact pending allocation. |
| Actors | Primary: Room Financial Lead. Supporting: Telegram platform. Includes UC03a and its included UC03b interpretation. |
| Trigger | The lead selects a billing period and uploads a meter photo or landlord invoice. |
| Basic Flow | 1. The lead identifies the room, billing period and electricity/water meter or landlord-invoice input.<br>2. TroMate verifies lead permission and supported media, then checks/reserves scan entitlement under EA04.<br>3. TroMate invokes UC03a, including UC03b, and receives extracted readings, prices, rent/fees and any questions.<br>4. TroMate displays the image and extracted values; the lead supplies missing prior readings/unit prices and corrects uncertain fields.<br>5. TroMate calculates consumption and charges under EA05, showing fixed rent and each fee separately and checking the calculated bill total.<br>6. The lead reviews the payer, beneficiaries and exact allocation, correcting any distribution that does not match the room's billing arrangement.<br>7. TroMate saves one versioned `PENDING` utility expense, broadcasts the reviewed breakdown and hands approval to UC05. Official balances remain unchanged until confirmation. |
| Alternative Flows | **UC04-AF01 Meter image only.** At step 1, no invoice is supplied. 1. Extract the current reading. 2. Obtain reviewed previous reading, billing period and tariff at step 4. Continue to step 5 only when sufficient billing inputs exist; a reading alone is not a payable debt.<br><br>**UC04-AF02 Invoice route.** At step 1, the lead supplies an invoice with or without meter evidence. 1. Extract fixed rent, readings, tariffs and fees through step 3. 2. Show any supporting meter comparison at step 4. Continue to step 5 after review.<br><br>**UC04-AF03 Scan quota or extraction failure.** At steps 2–3, quota is exhausted or the image is unusable. 1. Explain the quota/image problem and apply EA04 accounting. 2. The lead provides a replacement or enters supported reviewed values through text/manual correction. Resume step 1 for a new scan or step 4 for manual values; end without debt if abandoned.<br><br>**UC04-AF04 Missing billing fields.** At step 4, a prior reading, tariff, period or required fee is absent. 1. Identify every missing required field. 2. The lead supplies and reviews them, including first-cycle readings. Repeat step 4; missing fields are not interpreted as zero.<br><br>**UC04-AF05 Invalid meter delta or replacement.** At steps 4–5, current reading is below previous or a reset/replacement is claimed. 1. Flag the invalid delta. 2. Request corrected comparable readings or a reviewed fixed invoice amount; automatic reset/replacement calculation is unsupported. Return to step 4, or end without a proposal if no valid amount can be established.<br><br>**UC04-AF06 Invoice and calculation disagree.** At step 5, meter evidence or calculated charges disagree with the invoice. 1. Display both values and the difference. 2. The lead corrects the source fields or supplies a recorded reviewed invoice adjustment with a reason. Repeat step 5, then show the complete adjustment to all approvers at step 6. No unexplained difference is silently distributed.<br><br>**UC04-AF07 Corrected values or zero consumption.** At steps 4–5, the lead corrects a digit, tariff, rent or surcharge, or confirms valid zero usage/fee. 1. Recalculate affected components. 2. Display the corrected total and distinguish zero from missing. Repeat step 5 and continue to step 6 when valid.<br><br>**UC04-AF08 Membership or custom billing arrangement.** At step 6, occupancy changed or equal division is inappropriate. 1. Display affected members and the proposed split. 2. The lead supplies a supported fixed-share allocation. Automatic occupancy proration/tiered tariffs are unsupported under EA05. Repeat step 6; no silent redistribution to current occupants occurs.<br><br>**UC04-AF09 Existing billing-period invoice.** Before step 7, the same room/period bill appears to exist. 1. Show the existing proposal/entry. 2. If pending, use UC05's authorized revision; if confirmed, require the separate correction process. Only an explicitly identified additional bill proceeds to step 7. End with the existing result otherwise.<br><br>**UC04-AF10 Save, cancellation or approval rejection.** At step 7 or subsequent review, saving fails, the lead cancels or an involved member objects. 1. Apply SH05/SH06 or UC05-AF01. 2. Preserve reviewed inputs and the true saved status. End cancelled/failed/disputed or retry the unfinished save; no unapproved charge enters official balances.<br><br>**Shared alternatives:** SH01/SH02 at step 2; SH03 at steps 1–3/7; SH04 before step 7 returns to step 6; SH05 at steps 3/7; SH06 before commitment; SH07 during step 6 or UC05 review. |
| Pre-conditions | A lead attempts a scan for a selected room and billing period. Successful processing requires current lead permission and eligible room data; media readability and complete tariffs are checked during the flow. |
| Post-conditions | Success: one pending bill with reviewed source values, transparent formulae and exact shares; scans counted once. Failure/dispute: no unapproved utility debt. Meter history alone does not prove the invoice amount. |
| Rules and constraints | BR01–BR04; EA01–EA05, EA08 and EA10. Vision Features 2/3/6; V-NFR01–V-NFR08 as applicable. |

### 2.6 UC05 Confirm Reject or Edit Pending Expense

| Use case Name | UC05 Confirm / Reject / Edit Pending Expense |
| --- | --- |
| Brief description | Involved members approve the exact current proposal, or correct/reject it before any official debt is recorded. |
| Actors | Primary: each involved Room Member, including the payer and any lead participating in the expense. Supporting: Telegram platform. |
| Trigger | An involved member opens a pending expense card or selects an inline action. |
| Basic Flow | 1. The member opens the current pending proposal and reviews its payer, participants, amount, items and exact shares.<br>2. TroMate verifies the actor's room/participant permission and the proposal's current version/status.<br>3. The member selects Agree for the displayed version.<br>4. TroMate records that member's explicit approval once and shows the remaining required approvals.<br>5. TroMate checks whether every distinct involved person has explicitly agreed and no current objection exists.<br>6. When the rule is satisfied, TroMate atomically records the confirmed expense once and triggers UC07 to refresh derived balances.<br>7. TroMate displays `CONFIRMED`, the final allocation and approval/audit reference. |
| Alternative Flows | **UC05-AF01 Reject.** At step 3, an involved member selects Reject. 1. Record their objection and optional reason. 2. Mark the version disputed/frozen and notify the creator. End with the proposal unconfirmed; correction or creator cancellation is required before further commitment.<br><br>**UC05-AF02 Edit.** At step 3, an involved member selects Edit on an unconfirmed proposal. 1. Permit correction of the description, payer, amounts and participant allocation. 2. Validate all changes and save a new reviewed version, clearing prior approvals under EA01. Return to step 1 for renewed explicit agreement; the old version cannot be committed.<br><br>**UC05-AF03 Incomplete quorum.** At step 5, required approvals are still missing. 1. Show whose approval remains. 2. Keep the expense pending. End this interaction and resume at step 1 when another member reviews it; no official balance change occurs.<br><br>**UC05-AF04 No response.** After publication or at step 5, no further action arrives. 1. Keep the proposal `PENDING`. 2. Continue showing its current status when opened. End waiting; silence does not approve it and UC06 is outside scope.<br><br>**UC05-AF05 Stale or resolved card.** At step 2, the button refers to an old version or a confirmed/cancelled proposal. 1. Show the current version/status. 2. Discard the stale action. Return to step 1 for a current pending version, or end with the existing resolved state.<br><br>**UC05-AF06 Concurrent or repeated actions.** At steps 4–6, members agree, reject or edit simultaneously, or a callback repeats. 1. Recheck the current version and record valid actions once. 2. Apply EA01: a committed version cannot later be overwritten by an old rejection/edit; a revision committed first invalidates old approvals. Resume step 2 if terms changed, or end with the one actual durable result.<br><br>**UC05-AF07 Cancellation or lost permission.** At steps 2–3, the creator cancels or the actor is no longer eligible. 1. Permit the creator to cancel only an unconfirmed proposal; record cancellation. 2. Deny unauthorized actions and refresh any affected participant allocation under SH07. End cancelled/denied, or return to step 1 after an authorized revision.<br><br>**UC05-AF08 Commit, refresh or notification failure.** At steps 6–7, saving or derived processing fails. 1. Establish whether the confirmed ledger entry exists. 2. If not, retain pending status and retry safely; if saved, retain `CONFIRMED` and finish UC07/notification without a duplicate entry. End with accurate saved status and a visible refresh/delivery warning where necessary.<br><br>**UC05-AF09 Attempted edit/rejection after confirmation.** At steps 1–3, a member attempts to alter a confirmed expense. 1. Show its committed status and audit reference. 2. Explain the separate authorized correction process; do not mutate/delete the original entry. End with the confirmed ledger unchanged.<br><br>**Shared alternatives:** SH02 at steps 2/6; SH03 at steps 4/6; SH04 at steps 2–6 returns to step 1; SH05 at steps 6–7; SH06 before commitment; SH07 during review preserves existing confirmed obligations. |
| Pre-conditions | A proposal identity is supplied. Successful approval requires an unconfirmed current version and an eligible involved actor; stale/unauthorized attempts follow the alternatives. |
| Post-conditions | Success: exactly one immutable confirmed expense whose current involved persons all explicitly agreed. Otherwise: pending/disputed/cancelled state with recorded actions; no new official debt. A notification failure does not reverse a successful commitment. |
| Rules and constraints | BR01–BR03; EA01, EA08–EA10. Vision Feature 6; V-NFR02–V-NFR08, with text-action response expectations under V-NFR01. |

### 2.7 UC07 Simplify Group Debts

| Use case Name | UC07 Simplify Group Debts (Minimal Cash Flow) |
| --- | --- |
| Brief description | Derive exact member net balances and a minimum-transfer settlement plan from confirmed records, preserving active payment references. |
| Actors | Beneficiaries: Room Members and Room Financial Lead. Initiation is an internal confirmed-ledger event; TroMate's computation engine is not an external actor. |
| Trigger | An expense is confirmed, a receipt settlement is recorded, or the current official settlement view needs a refresh. |
| Basic Flow | 1. TroMate reads a consistent room snapshot of confirmed expenses, confirmed receipts and active payment references.<br>2. TroMate calculates each member's exact integer-VND net balance, excluding pending/disputed proposals.<br>3. TroMate constructs the fewest valid settlement transfers for eligible unreserved balances, preserving any active issued/claimed obligation under EA09.<br>4. TroMate verifies zero total net balance, unchanged member net positions and exact transfer reconciliation. In an unrestricted N-member plan, the result uses at most N−1 transfers; an existing reserved plan is reported separately.<br>5. TroMate publishes the result with its input version/calculation time, retaining underlying audited records and stable settlement references. |
| Alternative Flows | **UC07-AF01 Empty or fully settled room.** At steps 1–2, no outstanding confirmed balance remains. 1. Produce zero current balances and an empty settlement list. 2. Publish the successful empty result at step 5. End with no payment required.<br><br>**UC07-AF02 Circular debts cancel completely.** At step 2, all net positions are zero although expense records exist. 1. Eliminate the need for external transfers. 2. Preserve the original ledger/audit history. Continue to step 5 with zero obligations.<br><br>**UC07-AF03 Pending/disputed inputs.** At step 1, unconfirmed proposals are present. 1. Exclude them from official arithmetic. 2. Keep any pending-count display separate. Continue to step 2 using confirmed records only.<br><br>**UC07-AF04 Indivisible original allocation.** At steps 2–4, source shares require remainder reconciliation. 1. Use only an allocation already confirmed under EA03; do not independently re-round a member's debt during simplification. 2. If a source allocation is invalid, use AF05 rather than silently changing it. Continue to step 4 when exact values reconcile.<br><br>**UC07-AF05 Inconsistent ledger or output.** At steps 2–4, totals are inconsistent or the proposed transfers alter member net positions. 1. Stop publication and record the inconsistency. 2. Show the last valid plan labeled with its time, or an unavailable state if none exists. End requiring data correction; invalid arithmetic is never presented as debt.<br><br>**UC07-AF06 Input changes during computation.** Before step 5, another confirmation/receipt changes the snapshot. 1. Discard or withhold the stale candidate plan. 2. Read current state. Return to step 1 and publish only a consistent version.<br><br>**UC07-AF07 Active payment or receipt review.** At steps 1/3, an obligation already has issued instructions or a payment claim. 1. Preserve its debtor/creditor/amount/bank snapshot. 2. Calculate new unreserved balances separately; report any required reconciliation under EA09. Continue to step 4 without reassigning an in-flight transfer.<br><br>**UC07-AF08 Computation/storage failure.** At steps 3–5, calculation or publication fails. 1. Apply SH05 and a safe retry. 2. Show refreshing/unavailable status, or a clearly time-labeled previous valid result. End without publishing a fabricated zero or invalid plan.<br><br>**Shared alternatives:** SH03 at event receipt; SH04 before step 5 returns to step 1; SH05 at steps 1–5; SH07 preserves departed members' recorded obligations and does not redistribute them automatically. |
| Pre-conditions | An authorized room ledger snapshot can be requested. A nonempty balance is not required. Every confirmed source allocation is expected to obey exact-amount rules; violations follow AF05. |
| Post-conditions | Success: a versioned, exact settlement plan preserving each member's net position and active payment references. Failure: ledger and last valid result are preserved, with stale/unavailable status shown accurately. Simplification itself records no bank payment or receipt. |
| Rules and constraints | BR01/BR03; EA03, EA08–EA10. Vision Feature 4; V-NFR04, V-NFR05 and V-NFR07/V-NFR08. The source model's under-0.5-second calculation target is retained as a use-case-specific target; it is not substituted for Vision text/OCR targets. |

### 2.8 UC08 Settle Net Debt

| Use case Name | UC08 Settle Net Debt |
| --- | --- |
| Brief description | A debtor obtains payment instructions, transfers outside TroMate and has the identified obligation cleared only after its creditor confirms receipt. |
| Actors | Primary: debtor Room Member and creditor Room Member. A lead participates with the same permissions when debtor/creditor. Supporting: Telegram platform and the member-operated external bank application. |
| Trigger | A member selects an outstanding obligation or follows its payment link. |
| Basic Flow | 1. The debtor opens a current room obligation showing its creditor, amount and reference.<br>2. TroMate verifies access and invokes UC09 to provide exact QR/bank details and preserve the payment-reference snapshot.<br>3. The debtor checks those details and completes the transfer in their own bank application; TroMate neither executes nor verifies that transfer.<br>4. The debtor returns, selects Confirm Paid and uploads the transfer image. TroMate records a payment claim and shows Awaiting receipt confirmation.<br>5. The creditor reviews the claim/reference and independently checks that the exact funds reached their account.<br>6. The creditor selects Confirm Received for the displayed obligation and amount.<br>7. TroMate revalidates creditor permission/current state, records the confirmed settlement once, clears only that obligation and triggers UC07 for any remaining balances.<br>8. TroMate shows Settled with the receipt-confirmation time/reference and notifies the debtor and creditor. |
| Alternative Flows | **UC08-AF01 No payable obligation.** At step 1, the debt is zero or already settled. 1. Show the actual current status and any other remaining obligations. 2. End without a new QR or payment request.<br><br>**UC08-AF02 Missing details or QR failure.** At step 2, UC09 cannot produce usable instructions. 1. Show its specific missing-detail/generation explanation. 2. Retry corrected details or use UC09's supported readable-bank-details route. Resume step 2 or step 3 only with valid reviewed payment details; otherwise end Awaiting payment.<br><br>**UC08-AF03 Cancelled or failed bank interaction.** At step 3, the debtor cancels or their bank reports failure. 1. Leave TroMate Awaiting payment unless a payment claim is later supplied. 2. If explicitly confirmed that no transfer occurred, release the active instruction reservation. End without a settlement. Merely closing the bank app does not prove no funds moved.<br><br>**UC08-AF04 Unknown bank result or delayed return.** At steps 3–4, the debtor is unsure, closes the app, or transferred without completing the claim. 1. Instruct them to check bank history/creditor receipt before transferring again. 2. Preserve the payment reference and allow a later claim. Resume step 4 when the debtor reports the actual transfer, or end unresolved; do not prompt a duplicate full payment.<br><br>**UC08-AF05 Missing, unreadable or reused evidence.** At step 4 or creditor review, the screenshot is absent/inconsistent/unreadable. 1. Ask for clarification/replacement and flag a possible reused image. 2. Preserve the claim and original reference without treating OCR as receipt verification. Resume step 4 or step 5 after clarification; the creditor may instead use AF08 after checking their own account. End unconfirmed while unresolved.<br><br>**UC08-AF06 Non-receipt or wrong recipient.** At step 5, the creditor cannot find the funds or the evidence identifies another recipient. 1. Record the discrepancy and notify the debtor to check bank details/history. 2. Keep the obligation non-settled under Discrepancy under review; after both establish no transfer reached the intended creditor, return to step 2 for valid payment instructions. Otherwise remain under review. TroMate does not reverse an external transfer.<br><br>**UC08-AF07 Partial or excess amount.** At step 5, the received/reported amount differs from the obligation. 1. Record expected and reported amounts and evidence. 2. Explain that automatic partial/excess settlement is unsupported; preserve the discrepancy for explicit reconciliation rather than clearing the full debt. End under review, with no request to pay the whole amount again. A new exact obligation/claim may proceed only after reconciliation, outside this flow.<br><br>**UC08-AF08 Direct transfer confirmed by creditor.** At steps 4–5, the creditor independently finds an exact transfer made without the generated QR or debtor screenshot. 1. The creditor identifies the matching debtor, amount and obligation/reference in TroMate. 2. TroMate validates permission and asks for explicit receipt confirmation. Resume step 6, then record the one exact settlement at step 7.<br><br>**UC08-AF09 Withdraw mistaken claim.** At steps 4–6 before commitment, the debtor withdraws their erroneous claim. 1. Recheck that no receipt has been confirmed. 2. Record withdrawal and notify the creditor. Return to Awaiting payment; release the instruction only after explicit confirmation that no transfer occurred. If already settled, preserve it and explain the separate correction process.<br><br>**UC08-AF10 Unauthorized receipt confirmation.** At steps 6–7, a non-creditor, including another room lead, attempts confirmation. 1. Deny the action. 2. Keep the obligation awaiting the actual creditor's review. End without a financial change.<br><br>**UC08-AF11 Changed, duplicate or concurrent settlement.** At steps 4–7, the obligation changes or an action repeats. 1. Preserve the original payment snapshot/evidence and read the recorded state. 2. Return an already saved result, or require creditor reconciliation if current terms differ. Resume step 5 for unresolved review, or end with the existing settled result. A claim for one reference cannot silently settle another obligation.<br><br>**UC08-AF12 Save or confirmation-response failure.** At steps 7–8 after external money may have moved, the save/response fails. 1. Determine whether the receipt record committed. 2. Retry only the unfinished recording/refresh/notification; show Settled if saved, otherwise Awaiting receipt confirmation or review. End with actual status and instructions to check receipt rather than transfer again.<br><br>**Shared alternatives:** SH02 at steps 1–2/6–7; SH03 at steps 4/7; SH04 at steps 2/5–7 returns to review; SH05 at steps 2/4/7–8; SH06 during external interaction preserves actual saved/unknown transfer status; SH07 preserves departed members' recorded obligations. |
| Pre-conditions | An obligation/payment reference is supplied. Successful settlement requires an outstanding room obligation, valid recipient details and the creditor's independent receipt check. Invalid/stale references follow the alternatives. |
| Post-conditions | Success: one confirmed receipt settles the identified exact obligation only; remaining debts remain payable. Failure, abandoned transfer or discrepancy: no false receipt confirmation, no silently erased debt and no duplicate instruction to transfer funds. Evidence/status history is preserved. |
| Rules and constraints | BR01/BR03; EA06–EA10. Vision Feature 5, with manual receipt confirmation from the referenced decision record; V-NFR04–V-NFR08. |

### 2.9 UC09 Generate Dynamic VietQR

| Use case Name | UC09 Generate Dynamic VietQR |
| --- | --- |
| Brief description | Provide reviewed exact-amount bank payment instructions for a current obligation. The former “& Confirmation” wording refers to this handoff; actual receipt confirmation is specified in UC08. |
| Actors | Initiating actor: debtor Room Member through UC08. Recipient creditor supplies previously configured bank details. QR construction is internal behavior; no bank transfer is initiated here. |
| Trigger | UC08 requests payment instructions for an authorized current obligation. |
| Basic Flow | 1. TroMate receives the room, member and obligation/reference requested by UC08.<br>2. TroMate verifies authorization, outstanding status and the exact positive amount.<br>3. TroMate loads the creditor's configured bank/BIN, account number and account-holder details.<br>4. TroMate builds an EMVCo/VietQR-compatible payload using the exact amount and an ASCII transfer memo identifying the obligation.<br>5. TroMate displays the QR plus readable bank/account holder/account number/amount/memo, preserves the issued payment snapshot under EA09 and returns instructions to UC08 step 3. |
| Alternative Flows | **UC09-AF01 Invalid or resolved obligation.** At step 2, the reference is zero, settled, absent or from another room. 1. Show its permitted current status or deny access. 2. Generate no actionable QR. End; UC08 follows AF01 or the access failure path.<br><br>**UC09-AF02 Missing/invalid bank details.** At step 3, required data is absent or invalid. 1. Identify the missing field and tell the member that the account owner must correct configured details. 2. Do not guess another account. End without instructions; after authorized setup, UC08 retries this case at step 1.<br><br>**UC09-AF03 Invalid QR fields or memo format.** At step 4, amount/reference cannot be encoded as supplied. 1. Preserve the obligation's exact amount and identity. 2. Regenerate a valid standardized memo/payload, or report unsupported data if that cannot be done. Repeat step 4 when valid; never alter the debt amount merely to fit the code.<br><br>**UC09-AF04 Generator failure.** At step 4, QR generation fails. 1. Retry once under EA10. 2. If generation still fails but bank details/amount are valid, display readable instructions and record the same payment snapshot. Return to UC08 step 3 for manual transfer, or end with explicit failure when no valid instructions exist.<br><br>**UC09-AF05 Unsupported bank deep link.** At step 5, an app deep link is unavailable. 1. Retain the QR and readable fields. 2. Explain the scan/save/copy route supported by the member's banking workflow. Return to UC08 step 3; no unverified app link is promised.<br><br>**UC09-AF06 Unreadable or undisplayed QR.** At step 5, the QR does not render or cannot be scanned. 1. Offer regeneration or the readable bank-details route for the same reference. 2. Require the member to check the displayed recipient/amount. Resume step 4 or return to UC08 step 3 without creating another debt.<br><br>**UC09-AF07 Changed bank details or obligation.** At steps 3–5, the data differs from an existing issued snapshot. 1. Flag the old instruction as superseded in TroMate without claiming the bank QR itself can be revoked. 2. If no transfer occurred, obtain explicit confirmation and issue reviewed current instructions; if funds may have moved, preserve the original snapshot and return to UC08 step 5 for reconciliation. End with one clear current instruction or unresolved receipt review.<br><br>**Shared alternatives:** SH02 at steps 1–3; SH03 at step 1 returns/reuses the existing snapshot; SH04 before step 5 follows AF07; SH05 at steps 3–5 returns an accurate result to UC08. |
| Pre-conditions | UC08 supplies an obligation identity and authorized room context. Valid bank details and outstanding amount are validated in the flow rather than assumed to exclude failure paths. |
| Post-conditions | Success: exact QR/readable instructions and a stable reference snapshot are available. Failure: no guessed account, changed amount, bank transfer or settled status. Generating instructions alone changes no ledger balance. |
| Rules and constraints | BR01/BR03; EA06/EA09/EA10. Vision Feature 5; V-NFR04–V-NFR06 and V-NFR08. |

### 2.10 UC10 Send Scheduled Debt Reminders

| Use case Name | UC10 Send Scheduled Debt Reminders |
| --- | --- |
| Brief description | Politely notify a room debtor of a due unresolved obligation without duplicating reminders or demanding payment already under receipt review. |
| Actors | Recipient/beneficiary: debtor Room Member; Room Financial Lead benefits from the reminder. Supporting: Telegram platform. Initiation is an internal due-time event. |
| Trigger | The 24h or 48h reminder interval becomes due under EA07. |
| Basic Flow | 1. TroMate selects outstanding obligations whose next reminder interval is due.<br>2. TroMate rechecks current debtor, amount, receipt-review/settled status and the original obligation timestamp.<br>3. TroMate prepares a polite group message identifying the current debtor and amount with a valid TroMate link to the current payment details.<br>4. TroMate rechecks send permission and delivery identity for this obligation/interval, and verifies it has not just been settled.<br>5. TroMate submits the reminder to the bound Telegram group.<br>6. TroMate records delivered, failed or uncertain delivery status against that obligation/interval without changing any financial balance. |
| Alternative Flows | **UC10-AF01 Not due or already clear.** At steps 1–2, the interval is not due or the obligation is zero/settled. 1. Skip that selection. 2. Continue step 1 for other obligations, or end with no message when none qualify.<br><br>**UC10-AF02 Receipt confirmation/discrepancy pending.** At step 2, payment is claimed or disputed. 1. Suppress the debtor reminder under EA07. 2. Preserve current review status. End for that obligation; do not assert that the debtor has not transferred.<br><br>**UC10-AF03 Changed obligation.** At steps 2–3, amount, debtor or settlement arrangement changed. 1. Refresh current eligible obligations and preserve issued-transfer references under EA09. 2. Rebuild the message for the current valid obligation. Return to step 2, or suppress an obsolete selection.<br><br>**UC10-AF04 Unavailable payment target.** At step 3, bank details/link cannot support a valid payment action. 1. Do not send a broken or guessed QR/link. 2. Send only a factual reminder that payment details require correction, with a valid status-view link if available. Continue to step 4 for that accurate message, or record postponement if no useful route exists.<br><br>**UC10-AF05 Permission or Telegram delivery failure.** At steps 4–6, the bot was removed, cannot send or delivery fails. 1. Record the failure rather than claiming notification succeeded. 2. Retry one definite non-delivery under EA10 when possible; do not blindly resend an uncertain delivery. End with failed/uncertain status, or step 6 after a confirmed retry result.<br><br>**UC10-AF06 Replayed job or competing workers.** At steps 1/4, the same obligation/interval is selected again. 1. Read its existing claimed/delivery result. 2. Resume only a definitely unfinished send; otherwise reuse/suppress the existing outcome. End without a duplicate interval reminder.<br><br>**UC10-AF07 Missed schedule after downtime.** At step 1, both reminder times may already have passed. 1. Recheck current eligibility. 2. Select only the latest due unsent interval under EA07 and mark older missed intervals superseded. Continue to step 2 for one applicable message, or end if no longer eligible.<br><br>**UC10-AF08 Settlement during preparation.** Before step 5, receipt confirmation completes. 1. Recheck and cancel an unsent reminder. 2. If the message already left TroMate, make its link display current Settled status with no new payment demand. End with the actual delivery outcome and unchanged settled balance.<br><br>**Shared alternatives:** SH03 for event/interval replay; SH04 at steps 2–4 returns to step 2; SH05 at steps 5–6; SH07 prevents exposing/tagging departed users through an unauthorized new route while preserving room obligations. |
| Pre-conditions | A room obligation and reminder schedule exist. The bot's current permission and the debt's continued eligibility are checked before dispatch. |
| Post-conditions | Success: one applicable polite reminder submitted with recorded delivery status and a current action target. Suppression/failure: no misleading claim of delivery/payment/non-payment, no new debt and no financial state change. |
| Rules and constraints | BR01/BR03; EA07–EA10. Vision Feature 7; V-NFR03–V-NFR06 and V-NFR08. |

### 2.11 UC11 View Personal Ledger and Webview Dashboard

| Use case Name | UC11 View Personal Ledger and Webview Dashboard |
| --- | --- |
| Brief description | A member views current balances, their related expenses, authorized room ledger/history and read-only room details within the room's tier limits. |
| Actors | Primary: Room Member, including Room Financial Lead. Supporting: Telegram platform hosting the Mini App. |
| Trigger | A member opens the Mini App, a ledger/obligation link, or the /balance command. |
| Basic Flow | 1. The member opens TroMate from Telegram and selects the intended room/view.<br>2. TroMate verifies the current session and membership for the selected room.<br>3. TroMate determines current room entitlement and a valid requested history/filter range.<br>4. TroMate loads confirmed balances, current obligations, separately marked pending proposals and permitted ledger/room details.<br>5. TroMate displays who owes whom, exact amounts, entries and relevant statuses. Settled history follows the Free 30-day or Pro unlimited access rule; unresolved obligations remain accessible under EA08.<br>6. The member opens an entry, changes a supported filter/view, or follows an expense/payment action to its use case. A /balance request instead returns the equivalent basic text summary; no monthly analytics are generated. |
| Alternative Flows | **UC11-AF01 Empty room.** At steps 4–5, the successful query returns no entries/debts. 1. Show a clear empty state and true zero balances. 2. Offer existing expense-entry actions. End with a valid empty result, not a masked query failure.<br><br>**UC11-AF02 Personal/room/date filter.** At steps 3/6, a member chooses a supported filter. 1. Limit it to authorized room data and current entitlement. 2. Query the selected range. Resume step 4, then show the filtered result at step 5.<br><br>**UC11-AF03 No matching entries.** At step 4, a valid filter finds nothing. 1. Explain that no entries match. 2. Offer clearing/changing the filter. Return to step 3 if changed, or end with the empty filtered result; do not imply history was deleted.<br><br>**UC11-AF04 Invalid filter/range.** At step 3, the date range is inverted or the filter is unsupported. 1. Identify the invalid value. 2. Ask for a supported range/filter. Repeat step 3 before querying.<br><br>**UC11-AF05 Free history outside 30 days.** At step 3, older settled history is requested. 1. Explain the Free limit and show the accessible period. 2. Provide entitlement information without initiating an out-of-scope purchase. Return to step 3 with a permitted range or end showing available data; do not promise expired records can be restored.<br><br>**UC11-AF06 Unavailable analytics.** At step 6, monthly charts/category analytics are requested. 1. Explain that Feature 10 is later/Pro scope and is not delivered by these current use cases, even if the room already has Pro OCR/history entitlement. 2. Keep basic balances and history available. Return to step 5 with no fabricated analytics output.<br><br>**UC11-AF07 Entitlement change/downgrade.** At steps 3–5, the tier changes. 1. Re-evaluate history access. 2. Restrict older settled detail under EA08 while preserving unresolved obligations and necessary reconciliation evidence. Return to step 3; merely opening the dashboard does not delete ledger records.<br><br>**UC11-AF08 Load or refresh failure.** At steps 4–5, the query/refresh fails. 1. Show unavailable or visibly stale data with its actual refresh time. 2. Offer safe retry. Return to step 4 on retry, or end with an explicit unavailable/stale state rather than zero debt.<br><br>**UC11-AF09 Room switch or changed entry.** At steps 4–6, the member changes room, pages through changing data or opens a corrected entry. 1. Revalidate selected room access and refresh affected details. 2. Keep summary and entries consistent for that room/version, showing recorded corrections rather than overwriting history. Return to step 2 for a room change or step 4 for a refreshed view.<br><br>**UC11-AF10 Expired session or unauthorized direct link.** At steps 1–2/6, the session expires, membership is revoked or a link targets another room. 1. Apply SH02 and request reauthentication where appropriate. 2. Deny inaccessible data. Return to step 1 only after valid access, or end without disclosure.<br><br>**Shared alternatives:** SH01/SH02 at steps 1–2; SH03 for repeated read/action requests; SH04 at steps 3–6 returns to step 2/3 as appropriate; SH05 at steps 4–5; SH07 preserves obligations while restricting departed-member access. |
| Pre-conditions | Telegram provides a Mini App session or command identity to validate. Actual selected-room access and entitlement are checked in the flow. |
| Post-conditions | Success: an accurate authorized view or /balance summary within tier limits, with pending and confirmed states distinguished. Failure: no unauthorized disclosure, false zero balance or view-induced financial modification. Viewing never confirms an expense/payment. |
| Rules and constraints | BR01/BR03/BR04; EA08–EA10. Vision Feature 8; Feature 10 is explicitly deferred. V-NFR04–V-NFR08; /balance text response follows V-NFR01. |
